messages:
Marta H: quick sync — finalizing Park Summit booth runbook. need to lock swag qty, speaker slides drop deadline, and lead routing rules. who can own each?
Liam T: I can own swag orders and on-site inventory checklist. how many custom hoodies vs stickers?
Zara K: Hoodies 150? maybe 120. stickers and postcards unlimited :) also need speaker slide deadline — i think Thurs 9am PT works.
Sam R: +1 Thu 9am. I'll own speaker submissions follow-up and tech check scheduling. will set 15-min slots.
Marta H: perfect. Liam — vendor contact for hoodies? Marcus handles? @Marcus (Vendor)
Marcus (Vendor): yup we can do 120 hoodies + 500 stickers. lead time 14 days for hoodies after final art approval. need PO by next Tue.
Liam T: PO draft ready, will attach. can we get one mockup sample to SF office before printing?
Marcus (Vendor): yes, send shipping address. sample cost waived if PO > $2k.
Evan Ops: for on-site storage, we'll have a 4x6 bin assigned. need packing list labels with SKU and rough weight. I can bring a label printer.
Marta H: nice. SKU for hoodies: PARK-HOODIE-23. stickers: PARK-STKR-23. Liam add to PO.
Liam T: done. PO notes: ship sample to 225 Fillmore St, SF. will cc accounting.
Zara K: speaker slide plan — emails to speakers go out today reminding them of Thu 9am drop and 15-min tech checks. Sam pls confirm slots table.
Sam R: creating calendar invites now. will include Zoom link + backup USB instructions.
Marta H: lead routing — we want QR scan to create HubSpot contact and tag source=park_summit. current flow goes to marketing inbox then queue. propose: auto-assign to AE pool for first 200 scans, then nurture for others. thoughts?
Liam T: sounds good. can we add a flag for demos requested so we prioritize those?
Evan Ops: events-bot can add metadata on scan: demo_requested:true/false if they check checkbox on form.
Marta H: perfect. Sam — coordinate with growth to wire that field.
Sam R: on it, i'll ping growth now.
Zara K: swag pickup rota? I'll cover first shift 9-12, Liam 12-3, Marta 3-close. need one floater for restocking.
Marta H: volunteered floater: Sam can float. :raised_hands:
Marcus (Vendor): tentative delivery ETA Wed 5pm. please confirm receiving contact.
Evan Ops: Receiving contact: Evan Ops, (415) 555-0142. we'll accept Wed after 4pm.
Sam R: quick checklist snippet for on-site bag:
```
- hoodies (boxed by size)
- sticker bins
- postcards + one pagers
- tablet for QR scans + backup battery
- label printer + tape
- extension cord
```
Marta H: love it. final ask: marketing post around benchmark talk — Zahra will draft a short blurb + CTA to the demo sign-up. Zara can you draft and tag me for review?
Zara K: drafting now, will drop in #marketing-drafts by EOD.
Marta H: thanks team. next check-in tomorrow 10am PT. I'll update runbook with PO deadline and lead routing decisions. :calendar:
events-bot: Reminder scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 AM PT (Park Summit booth runbook sync).
